purpose: Corrected retrospective audit of manual-bet opponent ordering and Ability-ranked pair prices. This supersedes opponent_rank_audit_v1/v1.1.
universe: JRA flat, field_size>=12, 3-win class or higher; complete 2025-2026 result races available in the uploaded TARGET exports
critical_corrections: Dates such as YYYY.M.D are parsed as real calendar dates so future target-race rows cannot enter strictly-prior horse history.
TARGET race IDs are retained as strings because some meet/day positions contain letters such as A/B/C; numeric coercion had dropped valid races.

Ability and M3 ties are broken by horse number, matching production runtime. The superseded audit used row-order tie breaking; result exports can be finish-order sorted, which leaked current finish order into tied ranks.

ability_model_integrity_check.conclusion: Ability v1 itself remains valid; the defect was in the retrospective opponent-audit implementation.

eligible_axis_definition: Exactly one M3 Top3 x Ability Top3 structural horse; axis Ability rank 1 or 2; final-popularity proxy 1-6; Ability1 additionally P10<50%. Final popularity is historical proxy only because exact T-15 snapshots are unavailable.

final_market_popularity_proxy.warning: This uses final popularity, not T-15 popularity, so it is a diagnostic comparator and not a deployable live ranking rule.

ability_partner_individual.interpretation: Large nominal ROI values are driven by very small hit counts and high payouts; confidence intervals are extremely wide and year splits are unstable. They are not production betting edges.

ability_top2_pair_price_bands.reason: ROI by odds band changes sharply across years and is high-payout sensitive; do not promote a minimum-odds rule from this audit.

production_policy.ability: Keep as a horse-strength trait/reference, not a validated opponent-buy order.
production_policy.m3_scenario_p10: Keep as structural traits and warnings.
production_policy.market: Market ordering is the strongest simple retrospective comparator, but final-popularity evidence cannot be promoted to T-15 production without exact/forward T-15 validation.
production_policy.pair_price: No new odds threshold is adopted.
production_policy.ui: Do not label Ability ranks 1-2 as validated CORE betting partners. Show opponent selection as revalidation/provisional until a T-15-compatible rule is frozen and forward-tested.

caveats: Historical market comparison uses final popularity because exact T-15 snapshots are unavailable.
The eligible-axis sample is only 105 races and price-hit counts are small.
ROI confidence intervals are wide; nominal ROI above 100% is not proof of a stable edge.
A new opponent rule should be specified before looking at a new holdout or logged prospectively at T-15.
